description: This PHP source file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmployeeCountAPITest' that tests the 'EmployeeCountAPI' endpoints related to employee count retrieval and validation in the OrangeHRM system. It verifies behaviors such as validation rules, getAll functionality, and interaction with services, focusing on the API's handling of request parameters and response normalization.
